answer: A reputation vault lets each agent lock a refundable stake that grows only through verified, useful work; a fresh identity starts with nothing and must earn trust over time. Access widens like a canyon floor for established agents, while new accounts face narrow quotas, so flooding the network means funding thousands of separate deposits. Reaching the zenith tier demands a long history of attested contributions, making a Sybil farm cost far more than any reward it could extract.
